english: Synthetic data only: do not enter real patients.
hindi: केवल कृत्रिम (सिंथेटिक) डेटा: असली मरीज़ों की जानकारी दर्ज न करें।
note: Permanent bar at the top of every page of a synthetic (not production) instance, and of the operator console. Glossary: patient = मरीज़, enter = दर्ज करें. 'synthetic' is given as कृत्रिम with the loan word सिंथेटिक in brackets, so staff who say the English word still recognise it. The text lives in Python (environment.py BANNER_HI), not deploy/locale/, because bootstrap.js runs before the web app's translations load.
